answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 46 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in kernel, queued in knoll, and zephyr publishes the wait time. A farm of 75 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4803 identities would post 1225 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
